items.title: AI & the Death of Accuracy: What It Means for Zero-Trust
items.description: AI "model collapse," where LLMs over time train on more and more AI-generated data and become degraded as a result, can introduce inaccuracies, promulgate malicious activity, and impact PII protections.

items.title: Chinese Mustang Panda hackers deploy infostealers via CoolClient backdoor
items.description: The Chinese espionage threat group Mustang Panda has updated its CoolClient backdoor to a new variant that can steal login data from browsers and monitor the clipboard. [...]

items.title: Vibe-Coded 'Sicarii' Ransomware Can't Be Decrypted
items.description: A new ransomware strain that entered the scene last year has poorly designed code and an odd "Hebrew" identity that might be a false flag.
